# Release Dependency Correction

The Awtsmoos lets release archaeology reopen a sealed map when origin reveals a missing gate;
Awtsmoos.com must ship the reader covenant as one whole path, not let green source tests arrive too late.

## Discovery after final source audit

Comparing the tested dirty root against the newest `origin/main` proved that three Chitas-critical reader files remain outside the earlier frozen manifest:

- `geelooy/heichelos/post/functions/ui/nav.js`
- `geelooy/heichelos/post/functions/ui/chitasNav.js`
- `geelooy/heichelos/post/_awtsmoos.post.html`

`origin/main` still has the generic chapter-only navigation and the direct `$$sd` include. The working tree has the Chitas-aware navigation helper and a guarded reader include. The current clean local dynamic Chitas HTTP route depends on those working-tree bytes. Shipping only the earlier manifest onto newest origin would therefore regress the reader even though all range/schedule tests pass.

## Why these files belong to the feature

The dynamic reader synthesizes a seven-post virtual series. Reader previous/next gates must target the actual `chitas-YYYY-MM-DD` post IDs and preserve `chitasDate`; numeric chapter shorthand would attempt to treat a virtual series as persisted data. `chitasNav.js` supplies Daily Chitas day/portion labels and Hebrew/English interface copy.

The post shell must tolerate routes where server initial-data binding is absent or delayed. The guarded `typeof $$sd !== "undefined"` include keeps the native client reader capable of manifesting a dynamic post rather than failing before `postLogic.js` runs.

## Corrected frozen release surface

Add those three files to the previously frozen Chitas release surface. Do not absorb unrelated post-reader changes beyond their current complete-file bytes.

## Required new evidence

A dedicated reader-shell contract must prove:

1. `_awtsmoos.post.html` remains <=120 lines and guards `$$sd` before including `initial-content.html`.
2. `nav.js` remains <=120 lines and imports the Chitas navigation helper.
3. `chitasNav.js` remains <=120 lines, recognizes `daily-chitas`, maps post IDs to dates, and supplies bilingual day navigation copy.
4. Ordinary navigation remains present through the non-Chitas branch.
5. The full Chitas schedule/native-range/Living Path/discussion/deep-link gate still passes with these dependencies included.

## Release consequence

The clean integration worktree must receive these complete files together with the prior tested Chitas surface before any commit or deployment. This correction supersedes only the earlier release-manifest omission; it does not invalidate the native range architecture or the green second-pass evidence.

The Awtsmoos reveals that a doorway is part of the room whenever every learner must cross its frame;
Awtsmoos.com now freezes source, navigation, and shell together, so production receives one coherent name.
